title: Pine stand
summary: This starter is a small stand: a pine top on two legs. Replace its materials, parts and steps with your project.
priceNote: Example prices. Replace them with the prices at your store.

steps.title: Cut the parts

warn.text: Keep your free hand away from the saw. The teeth can cut your hand.

do: Mark one top A and two legs B on the board.
Cut each part on the waste side of the line.
Write the part letter on each part.
steps.check: Make sure that the two legs B have the same length.

steps.title: Attach the top to the legs
do: Stand the two legs B on a flat surface.
Put the top A on the legs with equal overhangs at the two ends.
Install two screws through the top into each leg.
steps.check: Make sure that the top does not rock on a flat floor.
